## ISL Exercise 5.4.2 (20pts)



:::{.callout-note}
As we learned the key to bagging is that trees are
repeatedly fit to bootstrapped subsets of the observations. This shows
that on average, each bagged tree makes use of around two-thirds of the
observations.
:::


## TCGA-BRCA via recount3

This is a self-contained script that runs the complete analysis:

- download and define labels
- do unsupervised filtering 
- run fold-specific supervised screening using either limma or absolute correlation on VST values
- fit within each fold
  + Ridge, lasso, elastic net (pick one)
  + Random Forest
  + Boosting Trees  
- evaluate via outer CV AUC 
- summarize stability by counting how often genes are screened.

:::{.callout-note}
This might be a long-running script (several hours). These are pseudo-code.  You should adapt it to your own needs, e.g., by reducing the number of folds, tuning grid size, etc.
:::

```{r, eval = F}
## ============================================================
## Tidymodels version scaffold:
## - outer CV with rsample
## - fold-specific preprocessing + screening (train-only)
## - compare: elastic net vs random forest vs xgboost
## ============================================================

## ---- packages ----
library(tidymodels)
library(matrixStats)
library(DESeq2)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)

## ---- 1) Download TCGA-BRCA gene-level data via recount3 ----
projects <- recount3::available_projects()

brca_info <- projects %>%
  dplyr::filter(file_source == "tcga", project == "BRCA")

if (nrow(brca_info) != 1) stop("Did not find a unique TCGA BRCA entry in available_projects().")

rse <- recount3::create_rse(brca_info, type = "gene")

# put counts on a usable scale
assay(rse, "counts") <- recount3::transform_counts(rse)

meta <- as.data.frame(colData(rse))
counts <- assay(rse, "counts")


options(yardstick.event_first = FALSE)

## ---- tidymodels helper: tune+fit glmnet via workflow ----
fit_predict_glmnet_tm <- function(train_df,
                                  test_df,
                                  alpha = 0.5,
                                  inner_v = 5,
                                  grid_levels = 30,
                                  seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)

  inner_rs <- rsample::vfold_cv(train_df, v = inner_v, strata = y)

  rec <- recipes::recipe(y ~ ., data = train_df) %>%
    recipes::step_zv(recipes::all_predictors())

  mod <- parsnip::logistic_reg(
    penalty = tune::tune(),
    mixture = alpha
  ) %>%
    parsnip::set_engine("glmnet") %>%
    parsnip::set_mode("classification")

  wf <- workflows::workflow() %>%
    workflows::add_recipe(rec) %>%
    workflows::add_model(mod)

  # penalty() is log10-scaled in dials by default:
  # range = c(-4, 1) => 1e-4 ... 10
  grid <- dials::grid_regular(
    dials::penalty(range = c(-4, 1)),
    levels = grid_levels
  )

  tuned <- tune::tune_grid(
    wf,
    resamples = inner_rs,
    grid = grid,
    metrics = yardstick::metric_set(yardstick::roc_auc),
    control = tune::control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
  )

  best <- tune::select_best(tuned, metric = "roc_auc")
  wf_final <- tune::finalize_workflow(wf, best)

  fit_final <- workflows::fit(wf_final, data = train_df)

  # probability column names are ".pred_<level>"
  prob_tbl <- predict(fit_final, new_data = test_df, type = "prob")

  # With your levels = c("Tumor","Normal"), we want Pr(Normal)
  prob <- prob_tbl$.pred_Normal

  list(prob = prob, best = best, tuned = tuned)
}


## ---- fold preprocess + dual screen, returning data frames for tidymodels ----
prep_fold_dual_for_tm <- function(counts_train, y_train,
                                  counts_test,  y_test,
                                  cpm_thresh = 1, min_samples = 10,
                                  var_quantile = 0.50,
                                  top_k = 500) {

  ## (a) TRAIN-only CPM filter
  cpm_tr <- edgeR::cpm(counts_train)
  keep <- rowSums(cpm_tr > cpm_thresh) >= min_samples
  ct_tr <- counts_train[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  ct_te <- counts_test[rownames(ct_tr), , drop = FALSE]

  ## (b) VST (same approach as your original: train and test each get VST)
  dds_tr <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = ct_tr,
    colData   = data.frame(row.names = colnames(ct_tr)),
    design    = ~ 1
  )
  dds_tr <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(dds_tr)
  Xtr <- assay(DESeq2::vst(dds_tr, blind = TRUE))  # genes x samples

  dds_te <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = ct_te,
    colData   = data.frame(row.names = colnames(ct_te)),
    design    = ~ 1
  )
  dds_te <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(dds_te)
  Xte <- assay(DESeq2::vst(dds_te, blind = TRUE))  # genes x samples

  ## (c) TRAIN-only variance filter
  v <- matrixStats::rowVars(Xtr)
  keep_v <- v >= quantile(v, var_quantile)
  Xtr_v <- Xtr[keep_v, , drop = FALSE]
  Xte_v <- Xte[rownames(Xtr_v), , drop = FALSE]

  ## (d1) limma screen
  sel_limma <- screen_limma_p(Xtr_v, y_train, top_k = top_k)

  ## (d2) SIS abs-corr screen
  sel_sis <- screen_sis_abs_cor(Xtr_v, y_train, top_k = top_k)

  ## Build tidymodels-ready data frames: rows = samples, cols = genes, plus y
  make_df <- function(X_genes_by_samples, genes, y_vec) {
    Xs <- t(X_genes_by_samples[genes, , drop = FALSE])  # samples x genes
    out <- tibble::as_tibble(Xs, .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(y = y_vec, .before = 1)
    out
  }

  list(
    train_limma = make_df(Xtr_v, sel_limma, y_train),
    test_limma  = make_df(Xte_v, sel_limma, y_test),
    train_sis   = make_df(Xtr_v, sel_sis, y_train),
    test_sis    = make_df(Xte_v, sel_sis, y_test),
    selected_limma = sel_limma,
    selected_sis   = sel_sis
  )
}


## ---- outer CV runner (dual) using rsample + workflows ----
run_one_cv_dual_tm <- function(counts_f, y,
                               K = 5,
                               inner_v = 5,
                               grid_levels = 30,
                               var_quantile = 0.50,
                               top_k = 500,
                               alpha = 0.5,
                               cpm_thresh = 1,
                               min_samples = 10,
                               seed = 1) {

  set.seed(seed)

  # resample only sample ids + y (avoid huge gene table in splits)
  sample_tbl <- tibble::tibble(sample_id = colnames(counts_f), y = y)

  outer_rs <- rsample::vfold_cv(sample_tbl, v = K, strata = y)

  all_preds <- vector("list", K)
  sel_limma_list <- vector("list", K)
  sel_sis_list   <- vector("list", K)

  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    split <- outer_rs$splits[[k]]
    tr <- rsample::analysis(split)
    te <- rsample::assessment(split)

    tr_ids <- tr$sample_id
    te_ids <- te$sample_id

    counts_tr <- counts_f[, tr_ids, drop = FALSE]
    counts_te <- counts_f[, te_ids, drop = FALSE]

    y_tr <- droplevels(tr$y)
    y_te <- droplevels(te$y)

    pp <- prep_fold_dual_for_tm(
      counts_train = counts_tr, y_train = y_tr,
      counts_test  = counts_te, y_test  = y_te,
      cpm_thresh = cpm_thresh, min_samples = min_samples,
      var_quantile = var_quantile,
      top_k = top_k
    )

    # Fit/predict via tidymodels workflow (inner tuning)
    fitL <- fit_predict_glmnet_tm(
      train_df = pp$train_limma,
      test_df  = pp$test_limma,
      alpha = alpha,
      inner_v = inner_v,
      grid_levels = grid_levels,
      seed = seed + 1000*k + 1
    )

    fitS <- fit_predict_glmnet_tm(
      train_df = pp$train_sis,
      test_df  = pp$test_sis,
      alpha = alpha,
      inner_v = inner_v,
      grid_levels = grid_levels,
      seed = seed + 1000*k + 2
    )

    all_preds[[k]] <- tibble::tibble(
      sample_id = te_ids,
      y = y_te,
      prob_limma = fitL$prob,
      prob_sis   = fitS$prob
    )

    sel_limma_list[[k]] <- pp$selected_limma
    sel_sis_list[[k]]   <- pp$selected_sis
  }

  pred_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(y = factor(y, levels = levels(y))) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(sample_id)

  auc_limma <- yardstick::roc_auc_vec(
    truth = pred_df$y,
    estimate = pred_df$prob_limma,
    event_level = "second"
  )

  auc_sis <- yardstick::roc_auc_vec(
    truth = pred_df$y,
    estimate = pred_df$prob_sis,
    event_level = "second"
  )

  list(
    auc_limma = as.numeric(auc_limma),
    auc_sis   = as.numeric(auc_sis),
    pred_df = pred_df,
    selected_limma = sel_limma_list,
    selected_sis   = sel_sis_list
  )
}


## ---- single run + ROC curves (tidymodels) ----
set.seed(1)
K <- 5

out <- run_one_cv_dual_tm(
  counts_f, y,
  K = K,
  inner_v = 5,
  grid_levels = 30,
  var_quantile = 0.5,
  top_k = 500,
  alpha = 0.5,
  seed = 1
)

cat("One-run outer CV AUC (limma):", out$auc_limma, "\n")
cat("One-run outer CV AUC (SIS abs-corr):", out$auc_sis, "\n")

# ROC curves via yardstick + ggplot2
roc_limma <- out$pred_df %>%
  yardstick::roc_curve(truth = y, prob_limma, event_level = "second")

roc_sis <- out$pred_df %>%
  yardstick::roc_curve(truth = y, prob_sis, event_level = "second")

plot(roc_limma$specificity, roc_limma$sensitivity, type = "l",
     xlab = "Specificity", ylab = "Sensitivity",
     main = paste("ROC (limma screen), AUC =", round(out$auc_limma, 3)))
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)

plot(roc_sis$specificity, roc_sis$sensitivity, type = "l",
     xlab = "Specificity", ylab = "Sensitivity",
     main = paste("ROC (SIS abs-corr screen), AUC =", round(out$auc_sis, 3)))
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)

## Stability across folds (single run)
sel_tbl_limma <- sort(table(unlist(out$selected_limma)), decreasing = TRUE)
sel_tbl_sis   <- sort(table(unlist(out$selected_sis)), decreasing = TRUE)

cat("\nTop 20 screened genes (limma) across folds:\n")
print(head(sel_tbl_limma, 20))

cat("\nTop 20 screened genes (SIS abs-corr) across folds:\n")
print(head(sel_tbl_sis, 20))


## ---- repeated outer CV (recommended) ----
set.seed(2)
R <- 10
aucs_limma <- numeric(R)
aucs_sis   <- numeric(R)

sel_all_limma <- vector("list", R)
sel_all_sis   <- vector("list", R)

for (r in 1:R) {
  out_r <- run_one_cv_dual_tm(
    counts_f, y,
    K = K,
    inner_v = 5,
    grid_levels = 30,
    var_quantile = 0.5,
    top_k = 500,
    alpha = 0.5,
    seed = 100 + r
  )
  aucs_limma[r] <- out_r$auc_limma
  aucs_sis[r]   <- out_r$auc_sis
  sel_all_limma[[r]] <- out_r$selected_limma
  sel_all_sis[[r]]   <- out_r$selected_sis
}

cat("\nRepeated outer CV AUC summary (limma):\n")
print(summary(aucs_limma))
hist(aucs_limma, main = "Repeated outer CV AUC (limma screen)", xlab = "AUC")

cat("\nRepeated outer CV AUC summary (SIS abs-corr):\n")
print(summary(aucs_sis))
hist(aucs_sis, main = "Repeated outer CV AUC (SIS abs-corr screen)", xlab = "AUC")

stab_limma <- sort(table(unlist(unlist(sel_all_limma, recursive = FALSE))), decreasing = TRUE)
stab_sis   <- sort(table(unlist(unlist(sel_all_sis, recursive = FALSE))), decreasing = TRUE)

cat("\nTop 20 screened genes overall (limma, repeats+folds):\n")
print(head(stab_limma, 20))

cat("\nTop 20 screened genes overall (SIS abs-corr, repeats+folds):\n")
print(head(stab_sis, 20))
```
